history.gap: The gold rule that runs through "Einde" is the one idea in the closer and it is not executed cleanly: on desktop it sits a few pixels above the baseline and shaves the feet of the E, n and d; on mobile it cuts through the letters at roughly x-height, reading as a rendering error rather than a device. At the bar the rule sits exactly on the baseline at every breakpoint (or clears the feet by a hairline), the sparkline starts after the word, and the empty right 60% of the closer is given a job — the "LIQUIDITEIT, SCHEMATISCH" caption is currently a whisper of low-contrast 9px text in a void. Secondary: the footer's link columns land at arbitrary x-positions (Discord at ~720, Educatie at ~1070) and the right column does not close to the same edge as the clock, and on mobile the disclaimer orphans "met zich mee." on its own line.
history.motion: Sections crossfade upward on a slow ease with the rule and sparkline drawing in — restrained and on-brand, but the incoming closer text ghosts over the footer clock mid-transition (frame 3) and the sheet shows no easing character beyond a fade.
history.verdict: A wins on discipline: one editorial device (rule-as-baseline becoming a sparkline), a coherent serif hierarchy, a gold restrained to hairlines and one CTA, and a footer that is merely under-gridded rather than broken. B has the more seductive atmosphere in motion, but its closer arrives with struck-through links, a colliding logo lockup and an empty headline void — a jury cannot shortlist a page whose footer looks like it failed to load.
